📲 WhatsApp Setup

Show the steps
  1. Google Sheet: open the 📄 WA Inbox template while signed in to your own Gmail and tap Make a copy (the script comes with the copy).
  2. Fill the script: in the copy open Extensions → Apps Script and change the top lines: TOKEN = a secret word / number of your own (not CHANGE-ME), GROUPS = the exact names of your WhatsApp groups (one per line, in quotes), OWNER_EMAIL = your e-mail. Save.
  3. Deploy: Deploy → New deployment → type Web app → Execute as: Me → Who has access: Anyone → Deploy → allow access → copy the Web app URL (it ends with /exec).
  4. MacroDroid (Play Store) on the Android phone that is in the WhatsApp groups: download the 📥 MacroDroid macro and import it in MacroDroid. Then open the macro and change 3 things: Trigger (Notification received - WhatsApp) → title = your group names, separated by | (e.g. Group A|Group B); HTTP Request → URL = your Web app URL; parameter token = your TOKEN. Allow MacroDroid to read notifications.
  5. WhatsApp: keep notifications of those groups ON (not muted) and keep the phone on / connected.
  6. This app: tap the button below and enter the same Web app URL and TOKEN (last row: 0). Then Production → 📥 Fetch WhatsApp.
  7. Fixed-time sync (optional): Production Update → 🕗 Scheduled sync at fixed times (20:00, 06:00, 11:00). The steps there let MacroDroid open the app at those times, so it syncs even when the app is closed.

🧾 ERP Entry Sheet (heat-wise)

Enter into ERP

📱 ERP from the phone (one-time set-up + daily steps)
  1. One time: press . In Chrome on the phone open any page → ⋮ → ☆ (bookmark) → Edit: Name Moltrix ERP, URL: delete it, long-press → Paste → save. (If Chrome is signed in on the PC too, the PC bookmark may already be there.)
  2. Daily: here in Moltrix pick the date (or make the Indent / Requisition list) → choose what to enter → 📋 Copy for ERP (phone).
  3. Open the ERP in Chrome (⋮ → tick Desktop site, so the ERP looks the same as on the PC) → open the right screen (Production Entry Listing / Production QC / Material to Material Transfer / Purchase Requisition / Store Issue Requisition).
  4. With the ERP page open, tap the address bar, type Moltrix ERP and tap the suggestion with the ☆ that drops down under the address bar - the panel comes up. Opening it from ⋮ → Bookmarks does not work (Chrome on the phone only runs it from the address bar).
  5. Panel → Paste → long-press the box → Paste → Load → tick the heats → Start.
  6. While it runs keep Chrome open with the ERP in front and the screen on (set the screen time-out to 10-30 min) - if the phone locks or you switch apps, Chrome pauses the page. Press – on the panel to make it small.
Set up the ERP bookmark (one time, on the PC)
  1. Show the bookmarks bar in Chrome (Ctrl+Shift+B).
  2. Drag this button onto the bookmarks bar: Moltrix ERP
  3. Daily: open the ERP → Production Entry Listing → click Moltrix ERP → Open Moltrix → pick the date here → Send to ERP → Start in the ERP.
  4. While it runs keep the ERP tab in front and don't click in it (a heat takes about 3-4 minutes; Chrome slows down tabs in the background).
  5. Every heat is checked line by line before Save. If an RM item has no stock or anything doesn't match, that heat is not saved and the reason is shown - fix it and Start again (saved heats are skipped).
  6. The ERP doesn't accept a Production Entry without at least one RM line, so production goes in together with the consumption. "Add RM consumption to vouchers already saved" adds lines that were missing earlier.
  7. Production QC: open Production QC in the ERP (Quick Search → QC → Production QC), click Moltrix ERP, pick "Production QC" here and Send. One QC per heat (series 2G HEAT WISE ANALYSIS) on the heat's first billet line, everything from the BIS Doc Final row (C, Mn, P, S, Si, N, S+P, CE, Bend, Camber, Length, Width, Freedom From Defects, Grade if the ERP asks), QC Time = heat date 10:00 (shift A), every test Pass. Only heats whose production voucher is approved can be picked in the ERP.

📱 App closed? Let the phone open it at these times (MacroDroid)
A web app cannot run by itself while it is closed. So the Android phone that is always on (the one with MacroDroid) opens the app at these times with the link below. The app then does the Fetch by itself, without any tap, and shows the result on the screen and in the 🔔 bell.
  1. On that phone, open this app once and sign in with your Microsoft account. Check that 📥 Fetch WhatsApp works by hand.
  2. MacroDroid → ➕ Add Macro, name: Moltrix - Auto Sync.
  3. Trigger: tap ➕ and search Day/Time. Set 20:00 and tick every day. Add the same trigger 2 more times, for 06:00 and 11:00. Any one of them starts the macro.
  4. Action 1: search Screen On and add it, so the phone wakes up.
  5. Action 2: search Website (open a web page / URL) and paste the link above. If Android asks which app should open it, choose this app - Moltrix (older installs still show SMS Reports; Chrome also works).
  6. Save the macro. To test it, change one trigger to 2 minutes from now and wait.
Keep that phone on charge with internet ON. Android → Settings → Apps → MacroDroid → Battery → Unrestricted. If the phone has a PIN / pattern lock, Android may keep the app behind the lock screen and the sync may not finish. A swipe lock (or none) works best. If the Excel file is open on the PC at that time, those messages are retried on the next fetch.
